notes: Jaden McDaniels went for 34 points, 10 rebounds, 6 assists and 4 threes for Thug Life, the best line of the night, and Thug Life still lost.
James Harden shot 5-of-14 for 21 points and 3 threes for Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw, the worst brick on the board in a 9-1 loss.
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander posted 38 points, 7 assists and 4 threes on 13-of-30 shooting for Adam Silver Dez Nuts, who left him on the bench.
Christian Anderson Jr. hit 6 threes for 25 points on 9-of-12 shooting. He is still on the wire, as are Kenrich Williams and Jalen Slawson.
MONSTARS beat Thug Life 6-4 behind Tyler Herro's 32 and Scottie Barnes' 31; Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw lost 9-1 to BrookynDynasty.
